name: Circulux Product Video
author: Ahsan Amin

sections.description:
Circulux Product Video adds video support to WooCommerce product galleries. You can use YouTube URLs, videos from the WordPress Media Library, and HTML5 video formats (MP4, WebM, Ogg).

What This Plugin Does

  • YouTube Integration: Paste a YouTube URL in the product video field.
  • WordPress Media Library Support: Select a video from your existing media library.
  • HTML5 Video (MP4, WebM, Ogg): Use self-hosted video files.
  • Manual Playback: Videos start when the user clicks play.
  • Thumbnail Layouts: Thumbnails are shown as a grid or slider based on item count.

Basic Features (Included Free)

  1. Universal Video Support: Embed YouTube or select videos from your WordPress Media Library.
  2. HTML5 Power: Full support for MP4, WebM, and Ogg formats directly on your product pages.
  3. Carousel Slider: Responsive slider with touch navigation and transitions.
  4. Mixed Media Gallery: Combine images and videos in a single, unified slider experience.
  5. Thumbnail Layout Logic: Uses a grid for fewer items and a slider for larger galleries.
  6. Responsive Layout: Designed to work across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  7. Customizable UI: Control arrow styles, colors, layouts (Vertical/Horizontal), and more.
  8. Frontend Assets: Includes only the assets needed for gallery features.
  9. HPOS Compatible: Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
  10. RTL Support: Full support for Right-to-Left languages.

Support & Feedback

We’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions!

📩 Email: ahsan.amin334@gmail.com

Third Party Libraries/Resources

This plugin uses the following third-party libraries:

  1. Swiper.js – MIT License
  2. Fancybox – Used for optional lightbox support.
  3. jQuery Zoom – Used for optional image magnification.

When you add YouTube videos to a product, the plugin embeds content from YouTube and may load the YouTube iframe API (https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api). YouTube is a service of Google; see YouTube’s Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Circulux Product Video”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this work with my theme?

It works with WooCommerce-compatible themes. If your theme follows standard WooCommerce templates and hooks, it should work correctly.

How do I add a video?

Edit a product, open the Product Video meta box, choose a video type, and add your video URL or select a media file. Save/update the product to apply changes.

Is there a limit on videos?

This version supports one primary video per product gallery.

Can I customize the gallery appearance?

Yes. Settings are available under Products → Circulax Video for layout, arrows, thumbnails, lightbox, and zoom options.
